query: INSERT INTO central.run_events (id, workspace_id, run_id, seq, node_id, attempt_id, kind, actor, reason_code, payload, recorded_at) SELECT $1, $2, $3, COALESCE(MAX(e.seq), 0) + 1, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, COALESCE($10, now()) FROM central.run_events e WHERE e.run_id = $3 ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING seq
